at_a_glance.storm_timing: Forecast: no rain or thunderstorm signal today
at_a_glance.best_window: Late morning through afternoon as residual seas ease

day_ahead.marine_summary: Forecast: NW 10–15 kt easing to 5–10 kt; seas 2–4 ft, occasionally 5; moderate chop. Dry with good visibility.
day_ahead.storm_outlook: Former Isaias has dissipated inland. No named Atlantic or Gulf storm currently threatens Coastal Georgia.

stories.headline: Microsoft calls for urgent global AI regulation
stories.summary: Microsoft President Brad Smith called for independent model evaluations, mandatory incident reports, victim notification and emergency shutdown capabilities. Current UK model reviews remain voluntary.

stories.headline: IMF says AI investment supports global growth
stories.summary: The IMF says AI infrastructure spending is helping keep 2026 global growth near 3%, with large benefits for Asian hardware suppliers. It also warns that roughly 40% of jobs could be changed or eliminated.

stories.headline: Ukraine says Russia broke energy ceasefire
stories.summary: Zelenskiy accused Russia of violating an energy ceasefire after a strike on a Kharkiv power plant. Moscow and Kyiv have not jointly confirmed the arrangement; the EU imposed additional Russia sanctions.

stories.headline: Senate control turns on expanding battleground map
stories.summary: Republicans hold a 53–47 Senate majority, but contests in Georgia, Michigan, North Carolina, Ohio, Texas and several other states are competitive. Polls remain close and control is unresolved.

stories.headline: Riyadh air traffic falls after deadly strikes
stories.summary: Riyadh's skies were largely empty after Houthi strikes on the international airport killed at least 12 people. Airlines suspended or rerouted flights, and the security outlook remains uncertain.
